text: In the example Channel 5 of DIO is assigned to core 1 and core 2 whereas channel 6 is assigned to core 2. Each core contains an IOHWAB module. Both modules are allowed to directly call Dio_WriteChannel() in their local core context. Limitation is that these only write to the channels assigned to the same core.
